mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers immediate central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as policy responses become priced into equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate robust near-term economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise month-over-month, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 95.0), declining industrial production signals potential economic contraction that prompts central bank rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as policy responses become anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or return in this regime is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When annualized quarterly GDP growth exceeds 2.0%, it signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to strong growth momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC over 1-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls above the 12-month moving average signals improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 12-month moving average, or average return in these periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When annual inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 3.0%, or average return in these periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers central bank policy responses, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as stimulus expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
